'''September 2000 Las Vegas tournament (23 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Hobbytown USA, Las Vegas, NV on 23 September 2000. [[Tim Guzman]] won it. It is known from Dan Christy's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1263">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-23-las-vegas-9-23-director-viewd1263/ las-vegas-9-23-director-view], DeckTech (Dan "Mystikal" Christy, 23 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-23-las-vegas-9-23-director-viewd1263/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Hobbytown USA, Las Vegas, NV
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Tim Guzman]]
